name: Runic Omen empower is consumed by the boosted Runeblade (#7456)
contract: #7456: every Runeblade stays +30% boosted once Runic Omen first triggers. Chain: talent 705580 procs counter 520285 per Runeblade to 3 stacks; the counter's own Effect1 (DUMMY trigger 705596) runs Empower(), which removes the counter and casts empower 705596 (+30%, aura 108). But 705596's DurationIndex 1 is 300000010 ms (~83 h) with no charges and no consume path (its aura-42 trigger 520756 is an empty unreferenced record), so the boost never ends. Fix: Empower() also removes 705596 on any later hit of the cycle, making it single-use; removal runs post-damage in all orders (Runeblade effects precede the proc-phase restack, and the restack's own Effect1 re-runs Empower idempotently). Rank 707144 (req 12, reporter's level band) binds through the same Effect1 shape as the base rank. Fails pre-fix at the final assert (empower still up after the 4th hit).
